title: The anti-rug end-to-end suite runs the real evaluator and circuit breaker but mocks the exit to always succeed and feeds one log per position, so a refused or failed escape, duplicate dispatches for one rug and sell-lock contention are never exercised; two cases ("partial sell preserves subscription", "full close terminates subscription") call no exit code at all

evidence.note: executeFullSell resolves true before every case; no case returns false, throws or hangs
Test 21 trips the breaker with three different positions, one Burn log each
dispatchEvent evaluates every matching log separately with no per-position dedupe (AUD-ANTIRUG-003: one rug, several logs, several dispatches)
triggerAntiRugExit result discarded: a refused or failed escape is never retried (AUD-ANTIRUG-004)
Test 22 performs no partial sell; its last assertion is expect(unregisterAntiRugPosition).toBeDefined() (:839)
Test 23 calls unregisterAntiRugPosition itself (:866) and then asserts the registry is empty; exitEngine is mocked, so the full-close cleanup hook it names is never run

sibling_sites_checked: All nine cases of the file, plus the other anti-rug integration files (botWiring, wsReconnectBackfill) for executeFullSell / triggerAntiRugExit returning false: none returns false. The fork anti-rug test (test/fork/antiRugDetector.fork.test.ts) is labelled in Task 2.
severity_rationale: S2: the exit mechanism is mocked to the success value on the anti-rug escape path, hiding the registered S1s AUD-ANTIRUG-003 and AUD-ANTIRUG-004 and the sell-lock refusal AUD-EXIT-014; two cases are hollow.
recommendation: Phase 28: add cases where the exit returns false, throws and stays pending (sell lock held), and assert the detector keeps the position flagged and retries; feed the Burn and Transfer logs of one LP removal and assert one dispatch and one breaker count. Replace Tests 22/23 with cases that run the real exitEngine partial-sell and full-close paths against a scripted provider.
affected_cases: Test 16: live path — all 3 signals trip → clearAllTimersForToken THEN executeFullSell with reason=anti-rug
Test 21: circuit-breaker trip — 3 successful exits → CB tripped → 4th evaluation returns early
Test 22: partial sell preserves subscription — entry remains; subsequent Burn still dispatches
Test 23: full close terminates subscription — unregisterAntiRugPosition called → subsequent Burn finds no position
escaped_regression: Today: an anti-rug escape refused by the sell lock or failing at the RPC is dropped and never retried (AUD-ANTIRUG-004), and one LP removal emitting Burn plus Transfer logs counts twice toward the breaker (AUD-ANTIRUG-003); every case stays green. Deleting the unregisterAntiRugPosition call from exitEngine full close also stays green (Test 23 calls it itself).
